provenance: Original Crystaleye editorial interpretations of common upright tarot symbolism, using existing CyberPunkTarotDeck artwork. Interpretations are reflection prompts, not guaranteed events. Source artwork filenames are retained, including original spelling.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.energy: Take one small, curious step into something unfamiliar, with enough preparation to keep it grounded.
cards.lesson: Notice where willingness to begin taught you more than waiting for certainty.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the possibility of a fresh start without needing to know the whole route.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.energy: Use a skill or resource you already have to make one clear intention tangible.
cards.lesson: Ask which resource was already available once you stopped looking for the perfect one.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the tools and support that can help you turn an idea into action.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.energy: Leave a little silence around a question; notice your impressions and check them against what you know.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what became clearer when you paused instead of demanding an immediate answer.
cards.gratitude: Make room for the clarity that can develop when you listen before acting.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.energy: Invest attention in something living or creative, including your own ordinary needs.
cards.lesson: Look for a moment when patient care helped something develop without being forced.
cards.gratitude: Be open to receiving nourishment and to enjoying what you have helped cultivate.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.energy: Give the day a useful structure and state a boundary before responsibility becomes resentment.
cards.lesson: Ask where a clear agreement helped and where a rigid rule could have softened.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the steadiness that grows from a realistic plan and shared responsibility.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.energy: Learn from a teacher or trusted practice, while checking whether its values fit your own.
cards.lesson: Consider which inherited rule offered support and which deserved a thoughtful question.
cards.gratitude: Welcome useful guidance and communities that make room for your own judgment.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.energy: Make a choice that matches your values and speak honestly with someone affected by it.
cards.lesson: Reflect on whether your actions agreed with what you say matters in a relationship.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate opportunities for mutual understanding and freely chosen connection.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.energy: Choose a direction and coordinate competing demands before trying to move faster.
cards.lesson: Notice what happened when determination served a clear purpose rather than a contest.
cards.gratitude: Welcome progress that comes from focusing your energy instead of scattering it.

cards.name: Strength
cards.energy: Meet a difficult feeling or conversation with patient courage instead of force.
cards.lesson: Ask where gentleness made a stronger response possible than immediate control.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the resilience you can build through kindness and consistent self-respect.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.energy: Protect a little quiet time to hear your own priorities before responding to the crowd.
cards.lesson: Notice which insight arrived when you stepped back from other people’s expectations.
cards.gratitude: Welcome thoughtful guidance and the clarity that can follow restorative solitude.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.energy: Respond to what is changing by choosing the part you can influence and loosening your grip on the rest.
cards.lesson: Reflect on how you adapted when circumstances changed beyond your preferred schedule.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate new possibilities that changing conditions can make room to notice.

cards.name: Justice
cards.energy: Check the facts, consider the consequences, and make a decision you can explain honestly.
cards.lesson: Ask where taking responsibility helped repair a situation more than defending your intention.
cards.gratitude: Welcome clearer agreements and the steadiness that comes from fair dealing.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.energy: Try a different viewpoint before investing more effort in an approach that is not moving.
cards.lesson: Consider what a pause revealed that pushing harder would have hidden.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the fresh perspective that becomes possible when you stop forcing a timetable.

cards.name: Death
cards.energy: Name a pattern that is ready to end and support yourself through one practical step of transition.
cards.lesson: Ask what you were ready to release and what support made an ending easier to face.
cards.gratitude: Make room for renewal and the energy that can return when an outdated commitment ends.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.energy: Blend effort and recovery into a pace that you can realistically sustain.
cards.lesson: Notice where a small adjustment worked better than an all-or-nothing response.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the steadiness you can cultivate through patience and workable balance.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.energy: Examine an automatic habit or obligation and identify one choice that returns a little agency.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a pattern you noticed without turning that awareness into self-blame.
cards.gratitude: Welcome opportunities to choose differently and seek support for loosening an unhelpful pattern.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.energy: If an assumption no longer fits, focus on immediate supports and one sound next step.
cards.lesson: Ask what became visible when an expectation was challenged, without insisting the disruption was deserved.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the chance to rebuild around what is sound, with help and a more honest foundation.

cards.name: The Star
cards.energy: Reconnect with one modest source of hope and give yourself room to recover.
cards.lesson: Notice a small action that restored confidence without requiring an instant transformation.
cards.gratitude: Welcome encouragement, replenishment, and the possibility of feeling more open over time.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.energy: Treat a strong impression as a question worth exploring, and verify details before deciding.
cards.lesson: Ask where uncertainty invited careful observation rather than a frightening conclusion.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the clarity that can emerge gradually and the imagination available along the way.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.energy: Make room for honest enjoyment and share a simple success without minimizing it.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a moment of ease or openness that deserved more of your attention.
cards.gratitude: Welcome ordinary pleasures, generous company, and the chance to enjoy what is already here.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.energy: Review a past choice honestly, then decide how you want to respond with what you know now.
cards.lesson: Ask what you learned without treating your earlier self as someone who should have known everything.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate a chance to answer differently and give a considered new direction a fair beginning.

cards.name: The World
cards.energy: Recognize a completed stage and gather what you want to carry into the next one.
cards.lesson: Notice what finishing or integrating an experience taught you about your own capacity.
cards.gratitude: Welcome a sense of completion and the freedom to begin again with a wider perspective.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.energy: State the central question plainly and separate facts from assumptions.
cards.lesson: Ask which honest observation cut through a confusing story.
cards.gratitude: Welcome a clearer conversation and a decision grounded in what you actually know.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.energy: Name the decision you are postponing and gather the missing information without waiting for perfect certainty.
cards.lesson: Notice what indecision protected and what it cost you.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the possibility of choosing with enough information rather than absolute assurance.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.energy: Acknowledge disappointment without making it a verdict on your worth; ask for the company or space you need.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what helped you face a painful truth gently.
cards.gratitude: Welcome honest support and the small beginnings of emotional repair.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.energy: Create a pause before your next demanding task and let rest be part of the plan.
cards.lesson: Ask what improved when you stopped treating recovery as something to earn.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate renewed perspective that a little protected quiet can make possible.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.energy: Consider whether winning an argument would damage something more important than the point at issue.
cards.lesson: Notice the difference between a useful boundary and an unnecessary last word.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the chance to disengage from a contest and make room for respectful repair.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.energy: Move toward a calmer arrangement one practical step at a time, allowing yourself to accept help.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what became easier when you created distance from a recurring strain.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the support and perspective that can accompany a gradual transition.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.energy: Choose a thoughtful approach while making sure privacy does not become avoidance of an honest agreement.
cards.lesson: Ask whether your strategy served a clear value or merely delayed an uncomfortable conversation.
cards.gratitude: Welcome opportunities to act with both discretion and integrity.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.energy: Write down what is genuinely constrained and one small action still available to you.
cards.lesson: Notice which assumption made the situation feel narrower than the evidence required.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate practical support and the possibility of finding more room to move.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.energy: Put a recurring worry into words and check it with someone trustworthy instead of debating it alone all day.
cards.lesson: Reflect on the difference between a feared outcome and something that actually happened.
cards.gratitude: Welcome reassurance, practical help, and a kinder way to meet uncertainty.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.energy: Recognize a stopping point and take care of the immediate basics instead of forcing another push.
cards.lesson: Ask what an exhausted effort taught you about limits and the need to stop.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the space for recovery that accepting an ending can begin to create.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.energy: Ask a precise question and verify what you hear before sharing it as fact.
cards.lesson: Notice where curiosity helped and where quick conclusions interrupted learning.
cards.gratitude: Welcome a useful idea or skill that begins with admitting what you do not yet know.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.energy: Give your argument a clear purpose and slow down enough to hear an important qualification.
cards.lesson: Ask where speed helped you act and where it outran your understanding.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the momentum available when courage travels with careful listening.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.energy: Be clear about a limit while leaving room for another person’s dignity.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a moment when directness was kinder than a vague promise.
cards.gratitude: Welcome relationships in which clarity and compassion can exist together.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.energy: Use evidence to make a considered decision, then explain the reasoning to people affected by it.
cards.lesson: Ask whether your authority served fairness rather than the need to be right.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the trust that consistent, accountable decisions can help build.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.energy: Make a little room for affection, a creative impulse, or a sincere offer of connection.
cards.lesson: Notice what you felt when you let yourself receive care without immediately repaying it.
cards.gratitude: Welcome emotional openness and the possibility of a nourishing new beginning.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.energy: Give a connection your full attention and make your own needs part of the conversation.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a moment when both people had room to contribute honestly.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate companionship built on mutual respect and freely offered care.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.energy: Reach toward supportive company and celebrate something small without needing a special occasion.
cards.lesson: Ask how shared enjoyment helped you feel connected rather than merely occupied.
cards.gratitude: Welcome friendship, encouragement, and moments worth enjoying together.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.energy: Check whether you need rest, a change, or a closer look at an offer you have dismissed.
cards.lesson: Notice what withdrawing helped you understand and what it kept you from receiving.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the possibility of noticing a worthwhile connection with fresh attention.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.energy: Give a loss or frustration its due while noticing one source of support that is still present.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what you missed and what remained available beside the disappointment.
cards.gratitude: Welcome support and the gradual possibility of seeing beyond what did not work out.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.energy: Let a happy memory inspire a kind gesture that fits your life now.
cards.lesson: Ask which part of a familiar pattern nourished you and which belonged in the past.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate simple affection and the chance to carry something good forward without recreating everything.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.energy: Choose one option to investigate rather than treating every appealing possibility as an equal commitment.
cards.lesson: Notice the difference between a compelling image and a choice you were ready to live with.
cards.gratitude: Welcome a dream that becomes more useful when you give it a practical next step.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.energy: Consider whether a familiar commitment still offers the meaning you need, then take a thoughtful next step.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what stepping back revealed about your changing priorities.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate room to move toward a more meaningful use of your attention.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.energy: Pause to enjoy something that is already satisfying before adding another condition to your happiness.
cards.lesson: Ask what genuine contentment felt like when it did not need to impress anyone.
cards.gratitude: Welcome ordinary pleasures and a more generous appreciation of what is enough.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.energy: Contribute to a supportive atmosphere through one honest, considerate act.
cards.lesson: Reflect on the daily behaviors that helped a relationship feel welcoming.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the belonging that people can build through repeated, mutual care.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.energy: Give an emerging feeling or creative idea a gentle way to be expressed.
cards.lesson: Notice what happened when you admitted a feeling before trying to polish it.
cards.gratitude: Welcome tenderness, imagination, and the chance to approach yourself with curiosity.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.energy: Offer an invitation or creative proposal with sincerity and a realistic promise.
cards.lesson: Ask whether an inspiring gesture was supported by dependable follow-through.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate a meaningful exchange that has room for feeling and practical care.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.energy: Listen carefully while checking what support you can genuinely offer.
cards.lesson: Reflect on how a compassionate boundary protected your ability to remain caring.
cards.gratitude: Welcome emotional understanding that includes your own needs as well as another person’s.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.energy: Make space for a strong feeling without letting it make every decision for you.
cards.lesson: Ask where emotional steadiness allowed a more thoughtful response.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate relationships that can hold honest feeling with patience and respect.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.energy: Give a practical opportunity a concrete first step and check what resources it needs.
cards.lesson: Notice which small investment of time or care created a useful foundation.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the possibility of gradual growth through something tangible and well tended.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.energy: Choose what needs your attention now and adjust a commitment that no longer fits your capacity.
cards.lesson: Ask what balancing responsibilities taught you about your actual limits.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the flexibility that comes from making a workable plan rather than juggling indefinitely.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.energy: Invite useful feedback and contribute your particular skill to a shared effort.
cards.lesson: Reflect on something that improved when expertise and cooperation worked together.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the satisfaction of learning with people who value each other’s contribution.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.energy: Review what you are protecting and whether holding so tightly is still serving your needs.
cards.lesson: Notice the difference between a helpful reserve and a rule that kept you from living.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the security that can grow alongside sensible generosity and flexibility.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.energy: Name a practical need and look for available assistance instead of assuming you must manage alone.
cards.lesson: Ask what made it difficult or possible to request support.
cards.gratitude: Welcome reciprocal care and the possibility of finding resources outside your usual route.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.energy: Give or receive help with clear expectations and respect for both people’s dignity.
cards.lesson: Reflect on whether an exchange felt freely chosen and balanced.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate support that meets a real need without creating an unspoken debt.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.energy: Check the progress of a long-term effort and make one informed adjustment before adding more work.
cards.lesson: Ask what your actual results taught you about where effort was being well spent.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the steadiness of patient growth and the freedom to revise a plan as you learn.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.energy: Spend a focused stretch of time on a skill and notice one small improvement.
cards.lesson: Reflect on how repetition changed something that once felt unfamiliar.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate growing confidence built through patient, imperfect practice.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.energy: Enjoy something your effort has made possible while respecting the limits that sustain it.
cards.lesson: Ask what self-sufficiency meant without turning it into a refusal of all support.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the pleasure of recognizing your own progress and making thoughtful choices.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.energy: Consider how a practical choice affects the people and commitments you want to support over time.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a resource or tradition that helped others as well as yourself.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate durable support, shared knowledge, and the chance to contribute beyond the immediate moment.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.energy: Choose one useful skill or practical goal and define a first exercise you can finish.
cards.lesson: Notice what you learned by approaching the basics without embarrassment.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the opportunities that patient study and a willingness to begin can open.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.energy: Keep a modest promise and check that your routine still serves a purpose you care about.
cards.lesson: Ask where consistency supported you and where habit needed an adjustment.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the trust and progress that dependable action can gradually build.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.energy: Make one part of your day more nourishing through practical care, without taking over everyone else’s needs.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what helped you feel supported in ordinary, material ways.
cards.gratitude: Welcome comfort and resourcefulness that include care for your own capacity.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.energy: Use a resource thoughtfully and make a decision that balances current enjoyment with future needs.
cards.lesson: Ask whether your idea of success supported a life you actually wanted to inhabit.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the steadiness that responsible stewardship and generous judgment can cultivate.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.energy: Give a lively idea a small trial before demanding that it become your whole future.
cards.lesson: Notice which spark became more meaningful when you acted on it.
cards.gratitude: Welcome creative energy and a fresh opportunity to explore what interests you.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.energy: Turn a possibility into a simple plan and decide what information you need before expanding.
cards.lesson: Ask what looking beyond the familiar taught you about your preferred direction.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the room to make a considered choice about what you want to explore.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.energy: Review what you have set in motion and prepare a useful next step without forcing the timing.
cards.lesson: Reflect on how patient preparation helped an ambition reach beyond its starting point.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the perspective and possibilities that sustained effort can make easier to notice.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.energy: Mark a small milestone with someone who helped make it possible.
cards.lesson: Notice how acknowledging a shared achievement strengthened your sense of belonging.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate a supportive base and the chance to enjoy progress in good company.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.energy: Distinguish useful differences of approach from a contest that is consuming everyone’s energy.
cards.lesson: Ask what a disagreement revealed about expectations that had never been made clear.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the chance to coordinate more honestly and turn competing energy into useful collaboration.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.energy: Accept appreciation without minimizing your work, and name someone else’s part in the success.
cards.lesson: Reflect on what recognition meant when it supported confidence rather than comparison.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate encouragement and the opportunity to help another person feel seen too.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.energy: Stand behind a considered choice while deciding which challenges actually require a response.
cards.lesson: Ask where holding your ground protected a value and where it became an automatic battle.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the steadiness that comes from knowing what is worth your energy.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.energy: Respond to an active situation with clear priorities and enough attention to avoid a rushed misunderstanding.
cards.lesson: Notice what helped you coordinate when several things moved at once.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate momentum that can carry an intention forward when communication stays clear.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.energy: Protect your reserves and decide what support would make continued effort more sustainable.
cards.lesson: Reflect on a boundary that came from experience without turning it into permanent suspicion.
cards.gratitude: Welcome the possibility of resilience that includes rest and shared responsibility.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.energy: Put down, delegate, or renegotiate one obligation before adding another task.
cards.lesson: Ask which load was truly yours and which had become yours through silence.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the space that can open when you make responsibility more realistic.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.energy: Try a small experiment that lets curiosity teach you something directly.
cards.lesson: Notice what became possible when you allowed yourself to be a beginner.
cards.gratitude: Welcome discovery and the creative confidence that can grow from low-stakes practice.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.energy: Act on an exciting possibility with a clear limit and a plan to follow through.
cards.lesson: Ask where enthusiasm served commitment and where it disappeared after the first burst.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate opportunities to bring courage and consistency into the same adventure.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.energy: Bring wholehearted encouragement to something you care about without carrying the entire room.
cards.lesson: Reflect on how confidence grew when expression did not depend on universal approval.
cards.gratitude: Welcome connection and creative warmth that leave space for your own needs.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.energy: Set a clear direction, invite useful input, and turn a broad ambition into a shared next step.
cards.lesson: Ask whether leadership helped other people act or simply kept every decision with you.
cards.gratitude: Appreciate the possibilities that open when vision is supported by responsible, generous action.
